about: BD-1238 (docs/241 W6 + W7): written targets for the V3 food map with the food at matching hosts (src/shared/FoodLayerDataV3Hosts.luau, tools/food_hosts.py), checked by tools/verify_food_hosts.py. Host shares are measured from the world geometry of the toon island: a berry inside a round bush footprint grown by bush_edge studs, a fruit under a tree crown, an amber or egg within rock_reach studs of a rock footprint or within landmark_band studs outside a landmark keep-out disc, an egg also within tree_foot_reach studs of a trunk. PROVISIONAL numbers, measured on the committed map and kept a little loose.
